item_title: Violent week a grim sign as targeted killings of police rise
item_description: Gene Johnson / Associated Press:  — The shooting deaths of two Connecticut officers and wounding of a third punctuated an especially violent week for police across the U.S. and fit into a grim pattern: Even as more officers left their jobs in the past two years, the number targeted and killed rose.
